text: A majority of respondents already took the regulatory regime into account in sizing assets under management before the Dodd-Frank Act was enacted, which implies that Dodd-Frank did not make much difference in how they run their business.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2732915

isBasedOn.name: The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study

abstract: It shows that a majority of respondents did in fact take the regulatory regime into account before Dodd- Frank, implying that Dodd-Frank did not make much difference in the way respondents run their business.
